## Cloud Run 5xx Error Spike (>15 errors in 5m)

A Gen2 Cloud Run service (`concierge`, `cloudcredit`, `y2kcardhunt`, or `y2kcardhuntpreview`) returned more than 15 `5xx` responses over a 5-minute window.

### Immediate Triage
1. Inspect Cloud Logging for `service_name` with `httpRequest.status>=500`.
2. Distinguish expected fail-closed `503` fallback responses (e.g. kill-switch active or Firestore limiter unavailable) from uncaught `500` crashes or OOMs.
3. Check upstream Gemini API status/quotas in the owning AI Studio project if `concierge` is failing.
